@JavascriptInterface
public void scanBarcode() {
    runOnUiThread(new Runnable() {
        public void run() {
            try {
                if (checkSelfPermission(android.Manifest.permission.CAMERA) != android.content.pm.PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
                    requestPermissions(new String[]{android.Manifest.permission.CAMERA}, 3001);
                    return;
                }
                _oniLaunchScanner();
            } catch (Exception e) {}
        }
    });
}

private void _oniLaunchScanner() {
    try {
        android.content.Intent intent = new android.content.Intent(this, com.journeyapps.barcodescanner.CaptureActivity.class);
        intent.setAction(com.journeyapps.barcodescanner.Intents.Scan.ACTION);
        intent.putExtra(com.journeyapps.barcodescanner.Intents.Scan.FORMATS, "ALL_CODE_TYPES");
        intent.putExtra(com.journeyapps.barcodescanner.Intents.Scan.PROMPT_MESSAGE, "Наведите камеру на штрихкод");
        intent.putExtra(com.journeyapps.barcodescanner.Intents.Scan.BEEP_ENABLED, false);
        intent.putExtra(com.journeyapps.barcodescanner.Intents.Scan.ORIENTATION_LOCKED, true);
        startActivityForResult(intent, 3002);
    } catch (Exception e) {
        try {
            com.journeyapps.barcodescanner.ScanOptions options = new com.journeyapps.barcodescanner.ScanOptions();
            options.setDesiredBarcodeFormats(com.journeyapps.barcodescanner.ScanOptions.ALL_CODE_TYPES);
            options.setPrompt("Наведите камеру на штрихкод");
            options.setBeepEnabled(false);
            options.setOrientationLocked(true);
            com.journeyapps.barcodescanner.IntentIntegrator integrator = new com.journeyapps.barcodescanner.IntentIntegrator(this);
            integrator.initiateScan(options);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }
}

@Override
public void onRequestPermissionsResult(int requestCode, String[] permissions, int[] grantResults) {
    super.onRequestPermissionsResult(requestCode, permissions, grantResults);
    if (requestCode == 3001) {
        if (grantResults.length > 0 && grantResults[0] == android.content.pm.PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
            _oniLaunchScanner();
        }
    }
}

@Override
protected void onActivityResult(int requestCode, int resultCode, android.content.Intent data) {
    super.onActivityResult(requestCode, resultCode, data);
    if (requestCode == 3002) {
        try {
            com.journeyapps.barcodescanner.ScanIntentResult result = com.journeyapps.barcodescanner.ScanIntentResult.parseActivityResult(resultCode, data);
            if (result != null && result.getContents() != null) {
                final String barcode = result.getContents();
                runOnUiThread(new Runnable() {
                    public void run() {
                        try {
                            org.json.JSONObject obj = new org.json.JSONObject();
                            obj.put("barcode", barcode);
                            String js = "if(window.onBarcodeScanned){try{window.onBarcodeScanned(" + org.json.JSONObject.quote(obj.toString()) + ");}catch(e){}}";
                            webView.evaluateJavascript(js, null);
                        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                    }
                });
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }
}
